metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for keeping AI-written codebases clean: scheduled maintenance and post-feature review with reviewer agents.

plugins.name: dd-cleanup
plugins.description: Scheduled and on-demand AI cleanup: static tools find candidates, one fixer, a build/analyzer/test gate, three reviewers and a verifier, then a draft PR.

plugins.name: dd-review
plugins.description: Post-feature review: deterministic gate, end-to-end check against the spec, one wave of role-scoped reviewers sized to the diff, a cross-model refuter, one guarded fix pass and a scoped re-check.
